verdict: supported within declared local-fixture scope, with one shutdown telemetry limitation; no demonstrated production defect

conclusions.evidence: Both JSON and SSE first feed completed with exact 10001-byte SHA. Exact replay has one nonretryable adapter_event_backlog_exceeded failure (JSON502/SSE200, SSE DONE1), starts/Send1.
conclusions.boundary: Real DOM extraction; explicit 10001-character relay is synthetic, not measured natural model token production.

conclusions.evidence: Before finishDom, actual health is HTTP0/browser1, owner not aborted and Chrome alive. Initial prefix has no terminal. DOM then completes; one-owner/one-Send replay has the exact 37-byte final hash and one completed terminal.
conclusions.priorFinding: Previous missing-http0 P2 is resolved by both source ordering and observed health.
conclusions.boundary: Same-process running journal only; no restart/durable-storage acceptance.

conclusions.reasonNoMask: Production cancellableBrowserTurn logically settles by cancellation race while physicalSettlement waits original worker finally and actual Chrome child close. Early worker entry throws and cannot satisfy final replacement-completed assertions.
conclusions.boundary: spawnAt is recorded after launchServer resolves, not OS process birth; source early-entry guard supplies ordering protection. Real launcher/helper end transport is replaced.

conclusions.evidence: While real child is alive: accepting=false, HTTP0/browser1 and admin/shutdown409. Real child close is observed. Final fixture cleanup gets TCP ECONNREFUSED; job scope has no leftover kills.
conclusions.unsupportedStrongerClaim: Natural production listener closure after physical exit, before fixture cleanup, is not conclusively isolated by the recorded telemetry.

findings.description: Any health error (including timeout or malformed JSON) is accepted as listener closed; the recorded TCP ECONNREFUSED check runs only after fixture server.stop(true). A transient health failure followed by fixture-forced stop could therefore satisfy this shutdown test.
findings.classification: potential false-positive evidence path, not an observed product failure
findings.requiredReportLimit: Claim busy409 + actual Chrome exit + final cleanup port refusal; do not claim separately proven natural shutdown socket closure.
findings.futureImprovementOnly: For a future authorized run, record the actual pre-cleanup refusal code with a fresh socket and accept only ECONNREFUSED. Do not rerun now.

scopeLimits: Fresh local page and owned Chrome only, not ChatGPT website/browser authentication or genuine model acceptance.
worker.run and preparation/model selection/submission/binding are replaced; only production server/adapter/registry/journal and DOM response loop are exercised.
Physical cancellation is split from the pending worker/Chrome promise, but normal completed-result versus independently delayed helper exit is not a distinct Chrome case.
signalShutdown invokes the installed production listener function directly; real OS signal delivery is not tested.
No absolute zero-regression or no-leak claim follows from these four bounded local cases.
